title: Kayaking
statementMd:
Vadim is really keen on travelling. Recently he heard about kayaking activity near his town and became very excited about it, so he joined a party of kayakers.

Now the party is ready to start its journey, but firstly they have to choose kayaks. There are $2·*n*$ people in the group (including Vadim), and they have exactly $*n* - 1$ tandem kayaks (each of which, obviously, can carry two people) and $2$ single kayaks. $*i*$-th person's weight is $*w*_{*i*}$, and weight is an important matter in kayaking — if the difference between the weights of two people that sit in the same tandem kayak is too large, then it can crash. And, of course, people want to distribute their seats in kayaks in order to minimize the chances that kayaks will crash.

Formally, the instability of a single kayak is always $0$, and the instability of a tandem kayak is the absolute difference between weights of the people that are in this kayak. Instability of the whole journey is the total instability of all kayaks.

Help the party to determine minimum possible total instability!

## Input

The first line contains one number $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$).

The second line contains $2·*n*$ integer numbers $*w*_{1}$, $*w*_{2}$, ..., $*w*_{2*n*}$, where $*w*_{*i*}$ is weight of person $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$).

## Output

Print minimum possible total instability.
statementZhMd:
Vadim 非常热衷于旅行。最近，他听说自己的城镇附近有皮划艇活动，对此十分兴奋，于是加入了一支皮划艇队伍。

现在队伍已经准备好开始旅程了，但首先他们必须选择皮划艇。队伍中有 $2·*n*$ 个人（包括 Vadim），他们恰好有 $*n* - 1$ 艘双人皮划艇（显然每艘可以搭载两个人）和 $2$ 艘单人皮划艇。第 $*i*$ 个人的体重为 $*w*_{*i*}$。在皮划艇运动中，体重是一个重要因素——如果同一艘双人皮划艇上的两个人体重差异过大，皮划艇就可能翻船。当然，人们希望合理分配皮划艇上的座位，以尽量降低皮划艇翻船的可能性。

形式化地说，单人皮划艇的不稳定度始终为 $0$，双人皮划艇的不稳定度等于乘坐这艘皮划艇的两个人体重之差的绝对值。整个旅程的不稳定度等于所有皮划艇不稳定度之和。

请帮助队伍确定可能的最小总不稳定度！

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$）。

第二行包含 $2·*n*$ 个整数 $*w*_{1}$、$*w*_{2}$、..., $*w*_{2*n*}$，其中 $*w*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个人的体重（$1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$）。

## 输出格式

输出可能的最小总不稳定度。
